source: netlab/netsim/{modules,extra,devices} + patched netsim/defaults/attributes.yml global (generated from upstream netlab with the public patch series applied)

features.core: map[_title:<nil> activate_af:Can control activation of individual address families advertise:Can advertise IGP prefixes community:Granular BGP community propagation confederation:BGP confederations import:Import routes from other routing protocols install_route:Supports bgp.install_route and bgp.allow_redist_default_route ipv6_lla:Can run EBGP sessions over IPv6 link-local addresses local_as:Supports local-as functionality local_as_ibgp:Can use local-as to create IBGP sesssions rfc8950:Can run IPv4 AF over regular IPv6 EBGP sessions vrf_local_as:Supports local-as within a VRF]
features.policy: map[_default_locpref:Device-wide local preference _title:BGP policy parameters aggregate:BGP route aggregation bandwidth:Support BGP DMZ bandwidth]
features.session: map[_title:BGP session parameters allowas_in:Allow own AS in incoming AS path (allowas in) as_override:Override AS in AS path bfd:Use BFD to detect BGP neighbor failure default_originate:Originate per-neighbor default route description:Use "description" attribute gtsm:Supports GTSM multihop:Supports EBGP multihop sessions passive:Supports passive BGP peers password:Supports MD5 passwords remove_private_as:Can remove private AS from AS path rs:Can be a BGP route server rs_client:Can be a client of a BGP route server tcp_ao:Supports TCP-AO session protection timers:Can configure BGP timers]

shapes.name: _r_import
shapes.description:
Routing protocol import specification. Each entry specifies a protocol to
import. Values might contain routing policies

shapes.name: _v_entry
shapes.description: Single network validation test (an entry in the validate dictionary)

shapes.name: _v_option
shapes.description:
A "show", "exec" or "valid" parameter in a network validation test. It's a
dictionary of device types with each value being a command to execute or
expression to evaluate.
